summary_md:
# 278. Mosaik eller lapptäcke?

**Feed**: aktiepodden  
**Published**: 2026-10-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Aktiespodden report-season episode covers a wave of Q3 reports. The large-cap engineering companies (ABB, SKF, Sandvik, Atlas Copco) posted solid numbers but the shares fell anyway, which the hosts put down to rising risk premia and AI-financing nerves rather than weak earnings. Swedish banks came in slightly below expectations on net interest income, though the hosts expect it to improve in 2027. Consumer retail stays weak, especially for companies exposed to the US consumer, while BioGaia, Mips, Lime and Medicover-adjacent bright spots show pockets of strength in a dark market.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 BIOG-B — BioGaia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

23% organic growth, margin 33%, Europe +38% after business-model shift to direct sales; APAC lagging but expected to improve.

#### Reasoning

Host called it a very strong report; the distribution-to-direct transition is complete and now bearing fruit. Tariff refunds boosted results only modestly. Upside if APAC orders materialise in Q4; stock rose against a falling market.

#### Sell Triggers

- APAC fails to accelerate in Q4
- Europe growth slows sharply
- margin gains revealed as one-off tariff refunds

> *"Jag tyckte det var en jättestark rapport."*

---

### 🟠 MIPS — Mips | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

25% organic growth, Koroyd acquisition growing ~30% vs 15% target; seen as most interesting retail stock but high multiples.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see Koroyd synergies/cross-selling as upside and call it fundamentally positive and 'fortsatt intressant'. Caution: high valuation multiples cause big moves on sales misses, and weak US consumer guidance.

#### Sell Triggers

- sales growth misses expectations
- US consumer weakens further
- Koroyd growth proves temporary

> *"Men jag tycker det här ser fortsatt intressant ut."*

---

### 🟢 LIME — Lime Technologies | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Beat by 5-6% on sales and EBIT, highest margin in 11 quarters, international growth, utility segment in Germany.

#### Reasoning

Host likes Lime: strong report, rising consultant utilisation as cyclical indicator, utility customers value reliability, and AI seen as short-term tailwind for established software vendors.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI disrupts CRM software moat
- consultant utilisation falls
- German expansion stalls

> *"jag gillar ju Lime och Vitec också"*

---

### 🟠 VIT-B — Vitec | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host likes Vitec; short-term AI may help software firms cut costs and raise prices, long-term survivors uncertain.

#### Reasoning

Mentioned briefly alongside Lime with a positive host view, but with acknowledged long-term uncertainty about which software niches survive AI.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI erodes vertical software pricing power

> *"jag gillar ju Lime och Vitec också"*

---

### 🟡 ABB — ABB | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Orders +40%, book-to-bill 1.24, strong guidance; fell 5% on risk-off; 18x EV/EBIT next year not excessive.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see fundamentals as excellent and the sell-off as driven by risk premium/AI nerves, urging calm. But they still prefer small caps for upside, so not an outright buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI data center capex slowdown
- order intake decelerates
- rotation out of large-cap engineering

> *"jag tycker ändå att man kanske kan ta kursaktionerna just nu med en smula en smula ro"*

---

### 🟡 SHB-A — Handelsbanken | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Best bank report, PD model approved boosting distribution room; NII expected to improve into 2027.

#### Reasoning

Hosts praise its credit quality and balance sheet and expect better net interest income in 2027 as rates rise, though Q3 was soft sector-wide.

#### Sell Triggers

- rate increases fail to materialise
- credit losses rise

> *"Handelsbanken excellerar igen i sin paradgred som är kreditkvalitet och balansräkning"*

---

### 🟠 MEDS — Meds | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Profit warning tied to transitory warehouse move; low valuation vs Apotea could bring tailwind.

#### Reasoning

Host views the warning as temporary and the stock as low-valued, suggesting a relative trade vs Apotea, but explicitly no official recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- warehouse issues persist beyond the move
- underlying demand weakens

> *"Så då kanske den här tycker jag då rätt lågt värderade aktien kanske kan få lite medvind igen."*

---

### ⛔ THULE — Thule | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Slowing growth, Quad Lock fading, margin gain almost entirely a 52m tariff refund, poor communication, weak US consumer.

#### Reasoning

Hosts call the communication weak and note the former growth engine Quad Lock appears to have stalled; underlying margin improved only 0.1pp.

> *"Exakt, det tycker jag är svagt rent kommunikativt."*

---

### ⛔ TDVOX — Tobii Dynavox | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

EBIT beat driven by reversed earn-out from an underperforming acquisition; North America sales cycles lengthening.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see the quality of earnings as poor and the communication unclear; the market reacted negatively to US reimbursement and sales-channel headwinds.

> *"det är knappast positivt heller"*

---

### 🟠 ALFA — Alfa Laval | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

ABB reported strong marine demand, where Alfa Laval has large exposure; host will follow the report closely.

#### Reasoning

A read-across from ABB's segment commentary suggests possible upside in the upcoming report.

#### Sell Triggers

- marine demand weakens
- process industry weakness dominates

> *"Alfa Laval är verkligen en rapport som jag kommer följa noga när den kommer."*

---
